old_caption: The video depicts a small cardboard structure resembling a building on fire. The structure is constructed from corrugated cardboard and features simple drawings of windows and a door, giving it a quaint, miniature appearance. Flames lick at the edges of the cardboard, consuming the material and causing it to curl and blacken. Ashes and debris scatter around the base as the fire intensifies. The background shows more cardboard boxes and a grassy area, suggesting an outdoor setting. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing closely on the burning structure, capturing the dynamic interplay between the flames and the deteriorating cardboard. The scene conveys a sense of controlled destruction, emphasizing the fragility of the materials used.

caption: The video depicts an outdoor scene on dry, pale grass where a small block of cardboard burns with a bright orange-yellow flame. The flame is already active and continues to flicker, rising as a single tall tongue, splitting into two prongs, and curling into looping shapes that lean left or right toward a hand-drawn cardboard tower marked with brick and arched-window lines. Its base remains anchored at the central burning block throughout. To the left lies a heap of gray, curled, already-burnt corrugated cardboard that stays static in shape and position. The drawn box and the flat cardboard base sheet hold their fixed positions, showing no new charring or collapse. A faint white smoke plume drifts slowly along the right edge of the base and behind the box.
